title: Rename billingUrl to billingEndpoint in shared-contracts and 3 consuming apps (mono)

summary: Renamed billingUrl -> billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and its 3 consumers (core-shell, sub-route-billing, sub-route-reports) via mono PR #1; CI and CD green. Assumptions: platformkit has no billingUrl reference (grepped), so no library release/bump needed; all 3 apps build locally.
